mapper.sql: select org.`id`, org.`name`, org.`icon`, org.`sort`, org.`remark`, org.`enabled`, org.`extension`, org.`tenant`, org.`level`, org.`parent_id`, org.`sequence`, org.`deleted`, org.`create_by`, org.`create_time`, org.`update_by`, org.`update_time` from `organization` org
mapper.select: SELECT DATA .* FROM ( SELECT @id AS _id, ( SELECT @id := parent_id FROM organization WHERE id = @id ) AS _pid FROM organization, ( SELECT @id := #{id}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @id > 0 ) ID, `organization` DATA WHERE ID._id = DATA.id ORDER BY `level`;
